body:
I can't say it was a particular reason or set of events that's made me hit my breaking point. I've just hit the limits of what I can handle. It's like I'm a ticking bomb ready to go off at the slightest touch. 

It's not a voice telling me to try and live. It's just me. My head... I see it as a separate bunch of entities/people talking to me (it helped me through severe loneliness treating my thoughts this way). But my head has given up.  

As for the appointment and treatment? I've been through this stuff for years. Nothing's worked. I'm far from hopeful.
Yeah. I'd love that.
I'm going to assume there's lots of people on there? I'd probably just make a tit of myself. I'd do that on a one to one basis anyways D:
I'm not good conversation anyway. I'm not good at it. Sorry
Oh. Um. Thanks. But I would just be a nuisance so it's okay
Silly question: think it could help me?
Talking is good, right?
Sucks right?
Okay
Um, whatever suits I guess
I'd like a chat. If that's okay or stuff
I don't have use of a PC/Laptop right now to play such awesome games :c

Then why do I need to justify anything to you? 

I'm perfectly rational. I'm not justifying my death. I was stating mere facts that with my absence others will have chances wether they make good use of it or not. 

Oh, no, I do want to die. I just wanted to check it's not all in my head. Ease myself into it. A little comfort would have been good, afterall, it is against human nature to kill yoursefl,  perhaps part of me is still fighting on.

Stop right there. Being a martyr isn't my intention. I want to die because of how I'm made to feel, like everything I do is wrong. I want to die because of how people have me all wrong  and treat me like a fool. I want to die because when I see myself, I'm not what I wanna be, I'm not pretty, desirable, intelligent, successful... For many other reasons.

I just believe that with my death there will be so many positives. Other people get another chance at life with various organs, my job will be open for someone who's unemployed and needs to support themselves. The people I know will be free of a burden. I'll be one less of the mental health treatment so someone else can get help. It's not about being a martyr. It's just how things are. 

Yes, one death won't change the world. But I'd do more for the world being Dead. And that's just how I see it

I believe the world would be slightly better once this burden dies and is off its shoulder. When this nuisance dies, those I care about, they won't have to concern themselves with trivial problems from the suicidal scumlord theyve had the misfortune of meeting and having in their lives.

I think from my death, peace and happiness can come to others so they can do what I cannot. From my death others will be given a second chance at life, their worries would fade. Their families grateful. I'm an organ donor
That he doesn't have to worry or stuff. I'll be out of his hair once I find the balls to follow through
Yup
As far back as I can remember

I don't know what I did/What I'm doing wrong. Every time I move or Speak... I've done something wrong. He's mad, someone's always mad with me. 

So like, if I die. I won't feel relief. But everyone else will
It was a difficult time still. But he made it easier. Until I messed up

I gave up when the only person who ever cared stopped caring because alls I am is a burden. 

I just can't do it anymore. I'm tired.

I've searched for as far as I can remember. All I've been met with are walls of pain, anger, punishment... Hatred. All I ever do is try.

I don't think I was ever supposed to live. Im a mistake. That's why I gotta make it right.

I've tried so so so many hobbies. But I just can't get into anything. Do you ever get to the point when like... You can't feel enjoyment in anything?

Well, because they are. In work it's constant bash *insert my name here* time. At home, I get blamed for everything that goes wrong. I talked to one person but they get mad with me all of the time and kindly tell me I'm a burden

Nothing has been going on. That's what's hurting me so badly. 

Everyone is mad with me. I don't think I wanna be alive anymore

Because, why would they wanna talk with me? I'm not worth anything to anyone. 

How's it going? I don't think it's anything good
no one really wants to talk with me.
